the genetic and functional analyses of MYO6 in Japanese hearing loss.
the genetic analysis of Japanese families with hearing loss and the molecular characterization of the MYO6 variants identified in the present study.
the clinical characteristics and in vitro analysis of MYO6 variants causing late-onset progressive hearing.

MYO6 gene variants are a cause of ADSNHL, which is characterized by a juvenile-onset progressive type with severe hearing deterioration after 40 years.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found 27 variants in the MYO6 gene and that these variants are responsible for the hearing loss in 2.4% of the Japanese patients with ADSNHL.
